regions.label: <house 1>
regions.prompt: Two-story coastal-style house with exterior walls fully clad in honed cream travertine stone with subtle horizontal banding, and crisp white trim. The complex roofline features dark shingles and multiple gables with decorative white trusses. On the image-right, a gabled porch with white columns and a sunburst-patterned truss shelters a white front door. A set of gray stairs with black railings and white posts leads up to this porch. Windows are white-framed with multi-pane grids; three are visible on the upper level and four on the lower level, some glowing with warm interior light. A white horizontal band separates the two floors. The house sits on a light gray foundation over a flat green lawn.

regions.label: <roof 1>
regions.prompt: Multi-gabled roof with dark charcoal shingles and thick white fascia boards. Two prominent forward-facing gables feature white decorative truss patterns with vertical and diagonal braces in their peaks. The gable on the image-left sits above a small white-framed window, while the larger gable on the image-right covers a set of three white-framed windows. A lower, horizontal roof section with matching dark shingles extends across the bottom center, sheltering a porch area. All roof edges are sharply defined by the white trim against the dark textured shingles.

regions.label: <porch 1>
regions.prompt: Front porch with a gabled dark-shingled roof and a white decorative sunburst truss in the gable peak. Two square white columns with decorative capitals support the roof, resting on a light-gray stone foundation. A white front door with six glass panes and a black handle is recessed behind the columns. Black railings with thin vertical balusters line the porch edge and the light-gray concrete steps leading up to it. The railings are punctuated by white square posts with pyramid-shaped caps. To the image-right, the house wall features cream travertine stone siding and two white-trimmed windows.

regions.label: <stairs 1>
regions.prompt: A set of light-gray concrete stairs leading up to a porch landing. The stairs are flanked by black metal railings with thin vertical spindles. White square wooden posts with pyramid-shaped caps anchor the railings at the base of the stairs, the landing, and the top of the first flight. The landing and stairs are part of a house with a light-gray textured foundation and cream travertine stone siding visible in the background.

regions.label: <window 1>
regions.prompt: Three identical, side-by-side vertical rectangular windows set into a cream travertine stone wall. Each window features a thick white frame and is divided into twelve small panes by thin white muntins in a three-by-four grid. The glass panes are dark grey with subtle vertical reflections.

regions.label: <window 2>
regions.prompt: A trio of identical, vertically oriented rectangular windows set side-by-side. Each window features a thick white frame and is divided into nine smaller panes by thin white muntins in a three-by-three grid. The glass panes are dark gray with subtle vertical reflections. The windows are mounted against a wall of cream travertine stone.

regions.label: <window 3>
regions.prompt: White-framed rectangular window with six panes arranged in two columns and three rows, separated by thin white muntins. The glass panes are dark and non-reflective. A thick white sill projects slightly from the bottom of the frame against a background of cream travertine stone.

regions.label: <window 6>
regions.prompt: Vertical rectangular window with a thick white frame and sill, set against cream travertine stone. The window is divided into two sashes: the top sash contains six panes in a three-by-two grid glowing with warm yellow light, while the bottom sash contains six dark panes in a matching three-by-two grid.

regions.label: <window 7>
regions.prompt: Tall, narrow rectangular window with a thick white frame and prominent sill, set against cream travertine stone siding. The window is divided vertically; the image-left pane glows with a warm golden light and is subdivided by thin white muntins, while the image-right pane is a single, dark grey glass surface.

regions.label: <plain 1>
regions.prompt: A flat, grassy plain. A long shadow is cast onto the grass at the image-left.

regions.label: <shadow 1>
regions.prompt: A dark, elongated shadow cast across a textured, olive-green grassy field. The shadow's upper edge forms a large, solid geometric block that angles from the top-left towards the center. Below this, thinner, parallel horizontal bands of shadow stretch across the lower half of the crop, with the bottom-most band featuring a serrated, comb-like edge on its right side.

regions.label: <sky 1>
regions.prompt: Clear, pale blue sky with a subtle horizontal gradient, transitioning from a slightly deeper blue at the top to a very pale, almost white hue near the horizon line. The sky is completely cloudless and uniform in texture.

layout.prompt: A 3d_render of a two-story <house 1> sits in the center of a vast, flat <plain 1> under a clear, pale <sky 1>. The <house 1> features a dark gray shingled roof with several gables and white trim. The exterior walls are finished in a light-colored, textured stone veneer. On the upper floor, a large three-paneled window is set into the image-right gable, while a smaller single-pane window is positioned in the image-left gable. The lower floor includes a covered <porch 1> with a dark gray roof and white support columns. A set of gray <stairs 1> with black railings leads up to the <porch 1> from the image-right. Several windows with white frames are visible on the image-left side of the <house 1>, including two on the upper level and two on the lower level. A small window is also visible on the image-left side of the <porch 1>. The <plain 1> is covered in short, green grass, and a long, dark <shadow 1> cast by the <house 1> extends towards the image-left. The <sky 1> is a uniform, light blue-gray, and the horizon line is slightly elevated in the background.
